title: Internal: handling procedure for reassigning a trainer on a Personal Training Packages package
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a member requests a trainer reassignment, or when staff perform one to reconcile the package's trainer-of-record with the trainer actually named on the most recent reassignment entry for that package, the agent records the new trainer assignment and any chargeable fee.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): reassign_trainer_0e491cd1.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package being reassigned, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- new_trainer_name: the name of the trainer being newly assigned, copied character for character from what the caller states or from the trainer name the reassignment is being reconciled to.
- reassignment_fee_usd: the amount to charge for this reassignment, in US dollars, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places; passed as 0.0 when the reassignment is free.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the new ledger entry's reference number, the newly assigned trainer, and the fee charged; the presence of a new reference number indicates the reassignment was recorded successfully, and the package's trainer-of-record is updated to the newly assigned trainer. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no ledger entry is created.
